settlementRules.description:
In the upcoming NBA game between Nuggets and Pelicans, originally scheduled for Saturday, November 14, 2026 at 7:00 PM ET (as of creation of the first market related to the event):
If the Nuggets win, the market will resolve to "Nuggets".
If the Pelicans win, the market will resolve to "Pelicans".
If this market's outcome was definitively determined under its rules by the listed resolution sources before abandonment, that outcome will stand. Otherwise, the following no-result provisions apply. If the game is canceled, does not start by Monday, November 16, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, or is abandoned with no official result by that time, this market will resolve 50-50.
The result will be determined based on the final score including any overtime periods.
